staticMarkdownSelectors.target: Synonyms and antonyms
節約 also readily describes saving electricity or time
matches: 節約 (せつやく), economizing or conserving, overlaps when reducing expenses. 節約 also readily describes saving electricity or time; 倹約 is especially associated with spending and a frugal way of life. This is a useful tendency, not a rule that every non-money use is impossible.

staticMarkdownSelectors.target: spending less does not guarantee that the difference is saved.
matches: 貯金 (ちょきん) means putting money aside. 倹約 can make that possible, but spending less does not guarantee that the difference is saved. 贅沢 (ぜいたく), luxury or extravagance, provides a contrast; it need not be a condemnation of an occasional treat.

staticMarkdownSelectors.target: Distinctive meaning
倹約 does not inherently call someone a miser.
matches: 倹約 does not inherently call someone a miser. けち generally criticizes stinginess: sensible thrift and unwillingness to spend or share are not automatically the same judgment. 倹しい (つましい), usually written in kana, describes frugal or modest living as an い-adjective.

staticMarkdownSelectors.target: neither is an unrestricted replacement for the other.
matches: Here English "economy" means thrift, not the national economy or academic subject foregrounded in 経済 (けいざい). 経済 also has a dictionary sense of being economical; the words are not opposites, but neither is an unrestricted replacement for the other.

staticMarkdownSelectors.target: Synonyms and antonyms
Compare 倹約する
matches: 倹約 (けんやく) concerns thrift and avoiding wasteful spending. Compare 倹約する, "economize," with つましい暮らし, "a frugal or modest life." 地味 (じみ), plain or unshowy, overlaps in descriptions of restrained living; it can also describe subdued colors without making a claim about spending. 贅沢 (ぜいたく), luxury or extravagance, supplies a contrast.
